Name: Vashti
Summary: Queen of Ahasuerus who refused his summons to display her beauty at his feast and was deposed, opening the way for Esther.
KeyVerses: Esther 1:9; Esther 1:11; Esther 1:12; Esther 1:15; Esther 1:16; Esther 1:17; Esther 1:19; Esther 2:1; Esther 2:4; Esther 2:17
LifeLesson: A refusal can change the course of a kingdom.
